title: SGLang-Omni extension ownership and lifecycle validation
summary: Place model, request-builder, scheduler, runner and communication changes at their actual owners and test completion plus abort/streaming failures.

zh-CN.title: SGLang-Omni 扩展职责与生命周期验证
zh-CN.summary: 将模型、请求构建、调度、执行和通信改动放在实际职责边界，并验证完成、取消和流式失败。

conditions: Fix architecture, checkpoint, endpoint and input/output behavior before selecting a similar pipeline.
Choose the reference pipeline by scheduling and state requirements rather than modality alone.

recommendations: Keep framework contracts model agnostic and use existing preprocessing/state/vocoder helpers only when their semantics match.
Preserve preparation/inflight/aborted ownership; splitting processes may require moving local shared state to a supported payload boundary.
validation_plan: Test invalid input, abort during preparation, late chunks, EOS/flush, repeated requests and resource cleanup.
On required hardware compare streaming/non-streaming completion, usage, finish reasons, quality and latency at baseline and concurrency.
limitations: Mocked or CPU lifecycle tests do not validate the real model, accelerator or media quality.
A factory or registry import failure should be diagnosed at its consumer rather than hidden or silently ignored.
This indexed abstract links to the complete bilingual skill and source evidence; it is imported guidance, not a benchmark result.
Accelerator execution, real-model quality and service performance remain unverified for this import. Qualify each target revision, model, backend and workload separately.
